newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Gas to offer Pa. customers a choice.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Gas to offer Pa. customers a choice.

text.p: Peoples Natural Gas customers in southwestern Pennsylvania will soon be able to choose their natural gas supplier as part of a new program known as "Energy Choice," the Pittsburgh-based utility said Tuesday.
Beginning April 1, Peoples will become the first Pennsylvania utility to offer such a program.
In April, gas suppliers will contact customers with information about their companies and the programs they plan to offer.
After reviewing the new material, the 317,000 residential, 29,000 commercial and 200 industrial customers will still have the option to remain receiving gas from Peoples.
The delivery of gas will not change, the utility said.
Peoples is the Pennsylvania distribution utility of Consolidated Natural Gas Co.
